GREETING
& CULTURE
The Republic of India is the world’s second-
largest country, after China. The landscape can
differ from the snowy peaks of the Himalaya in
the north to the turquoise beaches in the
tropical south. It’s impossible to not engage with
the Indian culture, it’s spicy food, mind-blowing
jewelry, vibrant celebrations and traditional
clothes. Therefore, it would be a shame to miss
out on this exciting trip through colorful India.

GREETINGS
Use the traditional Indian form of greeting, namaste,
which literally means, “I bow to the divine in you”.
Namaste is used for greeting, for taking leave, and
also to seek forgiveness. To greet someone with a
namaste, bring your hands together with palms
touching in front of your chest in a graceful fashion.

CULTURE
India’s diverse mix of traditions, spiritual beliefs and
colorful festivals will inspire and surprise you every
single day. The chaotic but simple lifestyle will
somehow relax you, so that you can focus on yourself
and all the experiences during your India trip.
Embrace India's unpredictability.

festivals, because their festivals can reach

harvest fairs that pay homage to a locally
worshipped deity. To experience each of
them is like living a hundred life's in one,
they are that diverse in their essence.
Nevertheless, the beauty of India is

DIWALI 
FESTIVAL OF LIGHTS
The most important festival in India is the Diwali, a
pan Indian festival, famous for lighting up our lives.
People celebrate the festival of lights, sending a
powerful message of the triumph of the good over
the evil.
HOLI 
FESTIVAL OF COLORS
Holi is an ancient Hindu festival that heralds the
arrival of spring after winter. It signifies the victory of
good over evil and is celebrated as a day of
spreading happiness and love. The festival is also
celebrated as thanksgiving for good harvest.

BEST TIME  
The best time to visit India is between
October and March when the monsoon
rains have ceased and the weather is
mostly warm and dry. The climate does
vary considerably by region.

DELHI
Delhi is a perfect mix of the Old and the
New India with its vibrant street life, the
authentic food and the inspiring markets.
Explore Chandni Chowk, one of the
oldest and busiest markets in the heart
of Old Delhi. Take an authentic ride with
a Rickshaw and stop by the Red Fort, the
Humayun Tomb and the appealing
Qutub Minar.
Discover the Golden Triangle
AGRA
In Agra city you’ll get to see the ivory-
white marble mausoleum – the Taj
Mahal. Just around the corner you can
walk through the Agra Fort and enjoy
the riverside view of the Taj Mahal. Stop
on your way for the magnificent fortified
ancient city, called Fatehpur Sikri. The
short-lived capital of the Mughal empire
is an architectural masterpiece.
JAIPUR

MUMBAI
Mumbai, formerly Bombay, is not only
India’s financial powerhouse, but also
the hub of the film industry and the
latest fashion. Mumbai is famous for
numerous fascinating places such as the
Gate of India, the tomb of Haji Ali
Dargah or the Elephanta cave. The
highlight is the historic Mani Bhavan, the
former residence of Mahatma Gandhi,
who peacefully fought for the
Independence of India.

VARANASI
AVaranasi is the India of your dreams.
Pilgrims from all over the world come to
this spectacular city to wash away sins
in the sacred waters of the Ganges
river. The so-called “City of Light” is
filled with intimate rituals of life and
Hinduism temples like the Vishwanath
Temple.
UDAIPUR
Udaipur, also known as the City of Lakes,
is the crown jewel of the state of
Rajasthan. Surrounded by several lakes
and the beautiful Aravalli Hills, Udaipur
offers postcard-perfect panoramas. The

RANTHAMBORE NATIONAL PARK
Being able to see tigers, crocodiles and many others
creatures in their natural habitat is a unique
experience. Become excited for the wild animals living
in the Ranthambore National Park and for the old
Ranthambore Fort.
Explore wildlife and beach
GOA
The coastal city Goa is a tropical Paradise with many
turquoise beaches. In town, walk around the Fort
Aguada and the Basilica de Bom Jesus, a famous Roman
Catholic basilica located in Old Goa. The history of Goa
as a former Portuguese colony is best preserved in 17th-
century churches. The colorful Panjim Market and the
Dona Paula viewpoint are perfect places to feel the
magic of India.

TRAVEL TIPS
4 things to know before visiting India

STAY HEALTHY
Never drink tap water and avoid things that
contain or are washed with it. (fresh fruit
juices, salads and street food)
USEFUL HINDI PHRASES
Break the ice with: "Namaskar" (hello),
"shukriya" (thank you), "aap kaise hai" (how are
you), "kitna hai" (how much) and "naam kya
hai" (what's your name).
SCAMS
In the big cities a lot of people offer you “good
deals”. Be clever and use a gps-tracking app
for Rickshaws and taxis. If any deal sounds too
good to be true, it probably isn't.
SAFETY
It’s especially important to be careful if you
are a Woman. We recommend to join group
tours and book Women-only rooms. Dress
conservatively and avoid traveling alone.

ITINERARY
With its astonishing history, the unique
celebration of diversity and all its
architectural wonders, your memories of
India will inspire you long after you have
left.

7-Day Golden Triangle
Tour -Delhi,Agra,Jaipur          
& Ranthambore Safari
Day 1: Arrival in Delhi
Arrive in Delhi. Transfer to hotel and check-in. If time permits, do some local
sightseeing in Delhi. Overnight stay in Delhi.
Day 2: Delhi City Tour and drive to Agra in the evening.
The tour will start with the pick-up from your hotel. Our driver will come to receive you
and then you will start the sightseeing tour of Old and New Delhi. Your tour guide will
meet you on the way and assist you all day.

In the evening, after sightseeing in Delhi, you will continue to drive to Agra City. Upon
your arrival in Agra, you will check-in your hotel and stay overnight in Agra.

Day 3: Agra City Tour and Drive to Ranthambore (264 km).
The driver and guide would come to your hotel at 06:00 AM and take you to see the Taj
Mahal during sunrise, the best time to visit Taj Mahal because it is less crowded, the
temperature is moderated and best for photography. Later come back to the hotel for
breakfast and check-out process.

After check-out, the guide will take you to Agra Fort made by the Mughal Emperor
“Akbar” in the mid of 15th century, you would also get a chance to see the riverside view
of Taj Mahal from this Fort.
After lunch around 12:00 AM drive towards Ranthambore to check-in and stay overnight.

After lunch around 12:00 AM drive towards Ranthambore to check-in and stay overnight.

Wake up early in the morning and proceed for 1st Jeep Safari into Ranthambore National
Park. Tigers are the major attractions at the Ranthambore National Park and there are
good chances of sighting tigers in the park during early morning and before dusk, as the
predators are quite energetic during early morning and evening. The other animals that
you can spot in the national park include leopard, sambhar, marsh crocodile, chinkara,
sloth bear, wild boar, chital, nilgai, mongoose, jungle cat and monitor lizards etc. It is
home to many birds also. According to experts, there are about 264 species of birds
living in the park.

Return to the hotel to breakfast. Spend the rest of the morning at leisure to visit other
places of Ranthambore including Ranthambore Fort, which was built in 10th century by
the Chauhan’s and Jogi Mahal, which has the second-largest banyan tree in India.

In the afternoon, proceed for 2nd Jeep Safari into Ranthambore National Park. Return to
your hotel in the evening to spend your overnight there.

Day 4: Morning & Evening Ranthambore Wildlife Safari by Jeep
Day 5: Drive to Jaipur (4-5h, 150-200 km)
In the morning, after breakfast, you will drive to Jaipur city from Ranthambore. After
arriving in Jaipur, you will check-in your hotel and stay overnight.

Day 6: Jaipur City Tour
The driver and guide would come to your hotel at 08:00 AM and begin the sightseeing of
Jaipur city. First, visit Amber Fort and also enjoy an Elephant Ride up to the entrance of
the Fort. Later visit Jal Mahal, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, and Jantar Mantar. You will also
have your lunch break in between the sightseeing. Later, completing the Jaipur
sightseeing, visit Colorful Bazaars in the evening or spend time in leisure by staying at the
hotel. Stay overnight in Jaipur hotel.
Day 7: Drive back to Delhi by Car – departure.
Our driver will come to pick you up from your hotel at 09:00 AM to drive back to Delhi.
You will arrive in Delhi around 02:00 PM. When you arrive in Delhi, our driver will drop you
back to your location (Hotel / Airport) anywhere in Delhi NCR / Airport.

VISA
If you want to travel to India, you’ll need a Tourist
visa. There are 3 ways to get the Tourist Visa. The
regular application is by paper/post. The second
option is the Tourist Visa On Arrival (TVoA), which is
allowed for a maximum of two visits in a calendar
year. The last and the most convenient way is the
online application for an e-Visa
(www.indianvisaonline.gov.in/evisa). The Electronic
Travel Authorization (ETA) takes two to four days to
get approved.
